title: Admission Counselor
description:
Job Description:

**Company:** IPCS Global  
**Location:** Tirunelveli  
**Salary:** ₹15,000 – ₹20,000 per month  
**Job Type:** Full-time  
**Experience:** Minimum 1 year in EdTech is mandatory

Job Overview

IPCS Global is looking for a **motivated and target-oriented Admission Counsellor** to handle student counselling, lead follow-ups, and admissions.

Key Responsibilities

* Counsel students and parents about suitable courses.
* Handle walk-in, phone, WhatsApp, and online enquiries.
* Generate, follow up, and convert leads into admissions.
* Achieve monthly admission and sales targets.
* Maintain student/lead records and regular follow-ups.
* Support seminars, workshops, and branch marketing activities.

Requirements

* Minimum **1 year of EdTech experience is mandatory**.
* Experience in academic counselling/admissions preferred.
* Excellent communication and convincing skills.
* Strong sales, follow-up, and relationship management skills.
* Target-oriented and able to work independently and in a team.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
